rows.text: calls p = `001C26B0(rdx)`; unless `rdx` is non-null while p is null, it calls `00584730` on the old qword `rcx+0x38` when that is non-null with bit 0 clear, and stores p to qword `rcx+0x38`; on every path it stores 1 to byte `rcx+0xE8`

skipped.why: 2468-byte body (about 600 instructions) with dozens of flag- and range-gated paths over dword rsi+0 bits 0x100/0x1000/0x2000/0x8000, words rsi+0x5C/+0x5E, the qword rcx+0xC0 record's bytes +6/+7/+0x13 and word +8, three 002DD7E0 lookup loops, and repeated 002752E0/0029F480 calls; every path cannot be stated within the 1,200-character limit, and a partial sentence would break the every-path rule, so it needs a hand-written multi-row treatment on the workstation

notes: 002986E0 skipped for size and branching only; its listing is readable. 001EADB0: the old-pointer release is guarded by `not al; test al, 1`, so 00584730 runs only when bit 0 of the old qword is clear.
